name: haestore
description: Hæstore — an artisanal general store. Root repo: docs, brand assets, and local infrastructure.

scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.mongo: docker compose exec mongo mongosh haestore
scripts.dev: npm run up && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix back-end run dev" "npm --prefix front-end run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix back-end install && npm --prefix front-end install
scripts.check: npm --prefix back-end run check && npm --prefix front-end run check
